BS.1770-5 Core Equations

Filter stages (K-weighting):

\[ H_1(z) = \frac{b_0 + b_1 z^{-1} + b_2 z^{-2}} {1 + a_1 z^{-1} + a_2 z^{-2}},\quad (b_0,b_1,b_2)=(1.5351,-2.6917,1.1984),\ (a_1,a_2)=(-1.6907,0.7325) \]

\[ H_2(z) = \frac{1 - 2z^{-1} + z^{-2}} {1 - 1.9900 z^{-1} + 0.9901 z^{-2}} \]

Block energy per channel \(i\), 400 ms blocks:

\[ z_i = \frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=0}^{N-1} y_i^2[n] \]

Channel-weighted loudness for one block:

\[ L_K = -0.691 + 10\log_{10}\Bigl(\sum_i G_i z_i\Bigr) \]

Two-stage gating:

\[ \Gamma_a = -70\ \mathrm{LKFS},\qquad \Gamma_r = L_{\text{prelim}} - 10\ \mathrm{LU} \]

Integrated loudness over gated blocks \(J_g\):

\[ L_{\text{integrated}} = -0.691 + 10\log_{10}\!\left( \frac{1}{|J_g|} \sum_{j \in J_g}\sum_i G_i z_{ij} \right) \]

Loudness Range (LRA), 3 s windows, 1 s hop:

\[ \mathrm{LRA} = P_{95}(l_j) - P_{10}(l_j) \]

Zwicker Loudness, Crest Factor & Peak Density

Approximate Zwicker loudness in sones uses specific loudness over Bark bands:

\[ N = \int_0^{24} N'(z)\,dz \approx \sum_{b=1}^{B} N'(z_b)\,\Delta z, \quad \Delta z \approx 1\ \text{Bark}. \]

We approximate band levels \(L_b\) (dB) as phons at each Bark band and use:

\[ N'(z_b) \approx \begin{cases} \left(\dfrac{L_b}{40}\right)^{2.6}, & L_b < 40\ \mathrm{phon}\\[4pt] 2^{\frac{L_b-40}{10}}, & L_b \ge 40\ \mathrm{phon} \end{cases} \]

so that a 40 phon tone is ≈1 sone when summed across bands.

For a time region \([t_0,t_1]\), band levels are averaged over frames:

\[ \bar L_b = \frac{1}{K}\sum_{k\in[t_0,t_1]} L_b(k), \quad N \approx \sum_b N'(\bar L_b). \]

Crest factor (in dB) for a region is:

\[ C_\mathrm{dB} = 20\log_{10}\left(\frac{x_\mathrm{peak}}{x_\mathrm{rms}}\right), \quad x_\mathrm{rms} = \sqrt{\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n}x^2[n]}. \]

Peak density (peaks / second) with threshold \(T\) (e.g. −18 dBFS) is:

\[ \rho_\mathrm{peaks} = \frac{N_\mathrm{peaks}}{T_\mathrm{region}}, \quad T_\mathrm{region} = t_1 - t_0, \]

where \(N_\mathrm{peaks}\) counts local maxima whose amplitude exceeds \(T\).

Persistent Masking Map (MPEG-1 Model 1) — Main
MPEG-1 Model 1 (Masking)

FFT and power spectrum:

\[ X(k) = \mathrm{FFT}\{x[n]\},\qquad P(k) = |X(k)|^2 \]

Bark mapping:

\[ z(f) = 13\arctan(0.00076 f) + 3.5\arctan\!\left(\left(\frac{f}{7500}\right)^2\right) \]

Tonal maskers:

\[ P_{\mathrm{tonal}}(k_m) = P(k_m-1) + P(k_m) + P(k_m+1) \]

Noise maskers per Bark band \(b\):

\[ P_{\mathrm{noise}}(b) = \sum_{k \in b}' P(k) \]

Spreading function:

\[ \mathrm{SF}(\Delta z) = 15.81 + 7.5(\Delta z + 0.474) - 17.5 \sqrt{1 + (\Delta z + 0.474)^2} \]

Individual masking thresholds (\(L_m\) in dB SPL):

\[ LT_i(z) = L_m + \mathrm{SF}(z - z_m) - \mathrm{NMT/TMN} \]

\[ \mathrm{TMN} = 14.5\ \mathrm{dB}\quad \text{(tonal)},\qquad \mathrm{NMT} \approx 3\text{–}5\ \mathrm{dB}\quad \text{(noise)} \]

Global masking threshold:

\[ LT_{\mathrm{global}}(z) = 10\log_{10}\!\left( 10^{ATH(z)/10} + \sum_{i\in\mathrm{tonal}} 10^{LT_i(z)/10} + \sum_{i\in\mathrm{noise}} 10^{LT_i(z)/10} \right) \]

Masking margin per bin:

\[ \Delta(k) = 10\log_{10} P(k) - LT_{\mathrm{global}}(z(k)) \]

Persistent Masking (Occupancy)

Band-time margin and binary mask:

\[ \Delta(b,t) = 10\log_{10} P(b,t) - LT_{\mathrm{global}}(b,t) \]

\[ M(b,t) = \begin{cases} 1, & \Delta(b,t) < 0 \\ 0, & \Delta(b,t) \ge 0 \end{cases} \]

Sliding-window occupancy over \(W\) frames:

\[ R(b,t) = \frac{1}{W} \sum_{k = t - W/2}^{t + W/2} M(b,k) \]

Persistent mask (occupancy ≥ \(\alpha\)):

\[ M_{\mathrm{persist}}(b,t) = \begin{cases} 1, & R(b,t) \ge \alpha \\ 0, & R(b,t) < \alpha \end{cases} \]

Energy gate (e.g. \(L_{\min} = -60\ \mathrm{dBFS}\)):

\[ A(b,t) = \begin{cases} 1, & L(b,t) > L_{\min} \\ 0, & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \]

Final persistent mask:

\[ M_{\mathrm{persist}}(b,t) \leftarrow M_{\mathrm{persist}}(b,t)\,A(b,t) \]

Persistent masking parameters (both tracks): α = 0.60 W frames (odd). Recommended analyzer defaults: α≈0.6, W≈9. Note: ISO/ITU standards don’t define α or W; this is an analyzer extension.

512-pt FFT, ~12 ms frames, 1/16 overlap, Bark-domain tonal & noise maskers + spreading + global threshold. Only persistent masked regions (per-band occupancy ≥ α) with energy above -60 dB are highlighted.

 Loudness calculation (K-weighting + BS.1770-5 gating) and
 MPEG-1 Model 1 psychoacoustic masking is implemented for offline analysis; persistent masking and margin
 are visualized in Bark–time space. α and W are analyzer parameters, not part of the ISO/ITU core spec.
